summary: FindLocationForWorksheet is a web form and codebehind in ASP.NET used to search for locations (destinations) that can be added to a worksheet. The interface allows users to filter and select destinations based on various parameters, view search results, and create worksheet entries for selected destinations.
purpose: The file enables users to locate and select destinations to be added to a worksheet for subsequent administrative actions. Its main use case is in organizing placements (e.g., in a healthcare or education context) by filtering, reviewing, and batch-adding selected destinations to a worksheet.

workflows.name: Search and Add Destinations to Worksheet
steps: User loads the FindLocationForWorksheet page with WorksheetID and CFOFlag as query parameters.
User enters/chooses one or more filters: keyword, agency, governing org, site type, service, region, province, discipline, include city/address.
User clicks Search (cmdSearch). The search is performed using the filter fields; gridData is populated with matching results.
User reviews the results and optionally uses Select All/None.
User checks desired destinations in the results grid.
User enters group size (if allowed by GWSFlag).
User chooses whether to use a template (chkUseTemplate).
User clicks Create (cmdCreate), which collects checked row keys and invokes Location.CreateWorksheetEntries to add them to the worksheet.
The system clears related cached lists to ensure new entries are reflected.
Optionally, the user can print (cmdPrint), clear (cmdClear), or close the form (cmdClose).

business_rules: WorksheetID and CFOFlag must be provided to enable Create functionality.
If GWSFlag is not true, group size defaults to 1 and the field is hidden.
If group size is required, it must be a valid integer (validated).
When no destinations are selected, Create does nothing.
validations: Keyword field may be required for search (CustomValidator2).
Group size must be an integer (CompareValidator4) and required if GWSFlag is true (RequiredFieldValidator2).
Multiple validation summaries for search and create actions.
UI disables Create button if prerequisite query string values are not present.
calculations: lblMatches displays the count of matched search results (loc.RowCount()).
conditions: If GWSFlag is true, allow group size input; otherwise, default to 1.
If WorksheetID or CFOFlag is missing, hide the Create button.
If MaxRowsHit is true, display a warning about too many results.
system_behavior: On Page_Load, validates URL hash, sets up the page, parses query strings, and initializes lookup data and controls.
Client-side JavaScript is initialized for controls.
Page_PreRender sets up the matches panel and group size visibility.
Search repopulates the grid and updates match count.
Clear resets filters, results, and the form state.
Create processes selected grid rows into worksheet entries.
Print launches report generation for search results and displays printable report HTML.
Error and warning panels are managed for user feedback.
dependencies: .NET WebForms infrastructure (GridView, Panels, Labels, Validators, etc.)
AJAX Control Toolkit for always-visible panels
exceptions: If query parameters are missing, some features are unavailable.
If group size is invalid or not entered when required, creation fails validation.
content_gaps: Exact structures of the backend entities (Agency, GoverningOrg, etc.) are not detailed in the source.
Implementation of certain helper methods and external dependencies (like CreateWorksheetEntries) is outside the file.
Front-end resources (localization, scripts, styling) are referenced but not included.
